agent_may_do: Cluster observations and draft problem statements
human_required_when: Always: choosing which problem deserves investment
evidence_or_gate: Named user evidence and falsifiable problem hypothesis
Source list with dates and claim-level citations

agent_may_do: Draft structured features dependencies and acceptance criteria
human_required_when: Ambiguous user outcome or irreversible scope choice
Breaking API security boundary data migration or vendor lock-in
evidence_or_gate: Architecture decision record and threat review

agent_may_do: Edit code run tests commit checkpoints and open a PR
human_required_when: Sandbox escape secret access destructive migration or scope growth over 20%
evidence_or_gate: CI passes and implementation maps to acceptance criteria

agent_may_do: Compare implementation with spec and report mismatches
human_required_when: Score below threshold or test evidence is incomplete
evidence_or_gate: Compliance score at least 0.90 in pilot design
rollback_path: Return to planner with mismatch report

agent_may_do: Track cost per feature and idea
human_required_when: Feature exceeds EUR 10 idea exceeds EUR 50 or loop count exceeds 3
rollback_path: Pause queue and require explicit override

agent_may_do: Prepare release notes deployment plan and rollback checks
human_required_when: Always for production until separately authorized and proven safe
evidence_or_gate: Human review CI security checks and rollback readiness
rollback_path: Revert release or restore previous version

agent_may_do: Summarize incidents clarifications rework and cost
human_required_when: Metrics regress or a new failure mode appears
evidence_or_gate: Recorded outcome and updated spec template
